title: Where do you need God's divine shield of peace tonight?
body_text:
He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty (Psalm 91:1).

As we begin this new week, surrender your concerns into His gentle care. Cast all your anxiety on Him, for He cares for you. Vote in our community poll below and type 'AMEN' in the comments to agree in prayer tonight. 🙏🕊️

poll.question: Where do you need God's divine shield of protection most tonight?
options: Peace of mind & freedom from fear/anxiety
